title: Honeymoon photos labelled Grand Central Station, a Mandela effect

tellings.quote: And so, I'm looking at my old photos of Grand Central Station, right? Well, Google it now. It's not called that. It's called Grand Central Terminal.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, kept honeymoon photos from New York in the early 1980s labelled "Grand Central Station." He tells Michels the name has since changed under him: "Google it now. It's not called that. It's called Grand Central Terminal." He takes this as a Mandela effect, the term for when people remember something differently from how the record now shows it, which some read as a sign that reality itself has shifted.
